summary: The proposed patch combines fast delete queries to reduce database roundtrips, which aligns with the issue description. However, there are some minor concerns regarding readability and potential edge cases.

issues.description: The patch assumes that combining queries with OR is always safe, but there might be edge cases where this could lead to incorrect deletions if the querysets are not properly isolated.
The use of the bitwise OR operator (`|`) for combining querysets may not be immediately clear to all developers. Adding a comment explaining this operation would improve readability.
